tool_input.command:
python3 -I - <<'EOF'
import re
txt=open('bib/2026-W42.bib',encoding='utf-8').read()
for m in re.finditer(r'@(\w+)\{([^,]+),(.*?)\n\}', txt, re.S):
    typ,key,body=m.groups()
    t=re.search(r'title\s*=\s*\{\{(.*?)\}\}',body,re.S)
    k=re.search(r'keywords\s*=\s*\{(.*?)\}',body)
    topics=re.findall(r'topic:([\w-]+)',k.group(1)) if k else []
    print(key,'|',typ,'|',','.join(topics),'|',t.group(1)[:150] if t else '')
EOF
